subject: DI03009011

body.en:
Definition

A domestic electrical installation is the consumer-side arrangement of conductors,equipment,protection and earthing that distributes electricity within a dwelling for intended use.

Explanation and application

  • Assess supply system,loads,environment and existing installation;select suitable segregation,isolation,overcurrent/residual protection and protective conductors under the applicable rules.
  • Keep Nand PEfunctions distinct,identify circuits and isolate all sources including PV/UPS/generator before work.No arbitrary downstream N–PEbond or shared neutral across unrelated RCDgroups.
  • IS732wiring practice and relevant earthing/product standards must be checked for applicable edition/scope;these notes do not substitute for a certified design or full standard text.
Demand versus diversity factor?

Demand=max demand/connected load;diversity=sum of individual maxima/group coincident maximum.

Reference: [1](https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Indian-Standards-on-Power-Energy-sector_compressed.pdf).
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Domestic installation એ dwellingમાં intended use માટે consumer-side conductors,equipment,protection/earthing દ્વારા electricity distribute કરતું arrangement છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Supply,load,environment/existing system assess કરી segregation,isolation,overcurrent-residual protection/PE પસંદ કરો.
  • N-PE functions અલગ રાખો.Circuits ઓળખી PV-UPS-generator સહિત sources isolate કરો.Downstream arbitrary N-PEbond/RCDgroups વચ્ચે shared N નકરો.
  • IS732 wiring તથા relevant earthing-product standardsનું applicable edition/scope ચકાસો.Notes certified design/full standardનો substitute નથી.
Demand/Diversity ફરક?

Demand=max/connected;diversity=individual maxima sum/group coincident max.

Reference: [1](https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Indian-Standards-on-Power-Energy-sector_compressed.pdf).

body.en:
Definition

A wiring layout is a dimensioned/located representation of points,control positions,circuit routes and equipment coordinated with the architectural plan.

Explanation and application

  • Show room use,lights,fans,sockets,dedicated appliances,DB,service entry and accessible switchboards;use a legend and point/circuit numbers.
  • Measure actual horizontal runs,risers,drops and approved routes;include conductors in each section,PEand terminal tails separately where not included.
  • Coordinate structural restrictions,wet/hot zones,accessibility and maintenance;heights/clearances come from applicable design rules,not one guessed universal number.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Wiring layout એ architectural plan સાથે coordinated points,controls,routes/equipmentની located-dimensioned representation છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Room use,lights,fans,sockets,dedicated appliances,DB,entry/switchboards બતાવી legend/numbers આપો.
  • Horizontal runs,risers,drops/routes માપો.Sectionમાં actual conductors,PE/tails અલગ લો જ્યાં included નહોય.
  • Structure,wet-hot zones,access/maintenance coordinate કરો.Heights-clearance applicable rulesથી લો;universal guess નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Connected load is the sum of rated connected input loads;maximum demand is the greatest simultaneous demand under a stated assessment/time basis.Demand factor is maximum demand divided by connected load on a consistent basis.

Explanation and application

  • Diversity factor=sum of individual maxima/coincident group maximum;it is not simply the reciprocal of demand factor.Units and kW/kVAbasis must match.
  • Use nameplate input or VA;output-rated motors need efficiency conversion.For one-phase real input Ib=P/(Vpf);for sinusoidal waveforms pf=cosφ.At fixed VA,Ib=S/V.Use true pffor nonlinear loads.
  • Simultaneity must be supported by the load profile/approved method.Dedicated appliances and future growth can control circuit count even if the arithmetic demand is low.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Connected load rated connected input loadsનો sum છે.Maximum demand stated assessment-time basis પર સૌથી મોટો simultaneous demand છે.Demand factor=maximum demand/connected load,same basisમાં છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Diversity factor=individual maximaનો sum/coincident group maximum છે;તે demand factorનો સીધો reciprocal નથી.kW-kVA/units સમાન લો.
  • Input/VA લો.Output-rated motorમાં efficiency લો.One-phase Ib=P/(Vpf),sinusoidalમાં pf=cosφ છે.VA માટે Ib=S/V લો.Nonlinear loadમાં true pf લો.
  • Simultaneity profile/approved methodથી લો.Dedicated load/growth circuit count વધારી શકે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Declared classroom grouping limits only:lighting/fan10points and800Wper circuit;power2points and3000Wper circuit.These are not asserted as universal current law.

Step-by-step solution

  1. For16lighting/fan points totalling980W,lower bound=max(ceil(16/10),ceil(980/800))=2circuits.
  2. Power loads2000,1800,1200,500,300Wtotal5800Wand5points.Lower bound=max(ceil(5/2),ceil(5800/3000))=3circuits.
  3. One feasible grouping is2500W(2000+500),2100W(1800+300),1200Walone.Check each circuit and dedicated-load rules,not the ceiling result alone.

Interpretation and check

Modern project requirements may impose different limits and dedicated circuits;state the question/standard basis before using legacy textbook values.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

ફક્ત classroom limits:lighting-fan10points/800W,power2points/3000W per circuit લો.આ universal current law નથી.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. 16points/980Wમાં max(ceil(16/10),ceil(980/800))=2circuits છે.
  2. Power loads2000,1800,1200,500,300W=5800W/5points છે.Lower bound=max(ceil(5/2),ceil(5800/3000))=3circuits છે.
  3. Feasible groups2500W(2000+500),2100W(1800+300)/1200Walone છે.દરેક circuit/dedicated rule ચકાસો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Actual requirements અલગ limits/dedicated circuits આપી શકે.Legacy values પહેલાં question-standard basis લખો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Assumed6LEDlamps12Weach,2fans60Weach,4socket loads100Weach,heater2000Wand ACinput1500W.All simultaneous,230V,aggregate pf0.9.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Pconnected=6×12+2×60+4×100+2000+1500=4092W.
  2. No demand reduction is assumed;S=P/pf=4092/0.9≈4546.67VA.
  3. Ib=S/V≈19.768A.Use the actual appliance inputs/pfand justified maximum-demand assessment in a real project.

Interpretation and check

The100Wsocket assignment is stated teaching load,not a universal socket load or its current rating.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Assumed6LED12W,2fans60W,4socket loads100W,heater2000W/ACinput1500W લો.All simultaneous230V/pf0.9 છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Pconnected=6×12+2×60+4×100+2000+1500=4092W છે.
  2. Demand reduction નથી.S=4092/0.9≈4546.67VA છે.
  3. Ib=S/V≈19.768A છે.Real projectમાં actual inputs-pf/demand assessment લો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

100Wsocket teaching load છે,universal load/current rating નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A wiring point is a specifically described outlet/control/load provision measured under the stated item definition;its scope is not identical in every SOR.

Explanation and application

  • Identify light,fan,bell,socket and dedicated power points separately;state whether fixture,fan,regulator,switchboard,conduit and labour are included.
  • Section conductor quantity equals section route length times the actual conductor count,plus stated tails/allowance.For a multicore cable purchase route cable metres,not core-metres.
  • Example:20mroute containing L,Nand PErequires60conductor-metres before allowance when all are separate single-core wires;one20mthree-core cable is20cable-metres.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Wiring point એ stated item definition હેઠળ outlet-control-load provisionનું measured unit છે.દરેક SORમાં તેનો scope સમાન નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Light,fan,bell,socket/dedicated points અલગ ઓળખો.Fixture,fan,regulator,board,conduit/labour included છે કે નહીં લખો.
  • Section quantity=route length×actual conductor count+tails-allowance.Multicore cable route-metresમાં ખરીદો,core-metresમાં નહીં.
  • 20mrouteમાં separate L,N/PE single-cores હોય તો60conductor-metres છે.એક20mthree-core cable માટે20cable-metres છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Ib is design current,Inprotective-device nominal/setting current and Izcorrected conductor ampacity under actual conditions;use a coordinated approved protection design.

Step-by-step solution

  1. For a declared table rating Itab32Aand total correction factor0.8,Iz=32×0.8=25.6A.
  2. If Ib19.8Aand selected In25A,then19.8≤25≤25.6meets the basic current inequality Ib≤In≤Iz.
  3. Also verify overload operating condition,voltage drop,short-circuit energy,disconnection/loop impedance,installation,terminal limits and device breaking capacity.

Interpretation and check

The table rating is assumed data,not a universal rating for a named mm²size.Ib≤In≤Izalone does not prove compliance.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Ib design I,In protective setting/rating અને Iz actual conditionsમાં corrected conductor ampacity છે.Coordinated design લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Declared Itab32A/factor0.8માં Iz=32×0.8=25.6A છે.
  2. Ib19.8A/In25Aમાં19.8≤25≤25.6થી basic inequality મળે.
  3. Overload operation,Vdrop,SCenergy,disconnection-loop Z,installation/terminals/breaking capacity પણ verify કરો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Table rating assumed છે;કોઈ mm²sizeની universal rating નથી.Inequality એકલી compliance proof નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Single-phase two-wire circuit,one-way length ℓ,per-conductor r/x,current Ilagging by φ;small-drop approximation.

Step-by-step solution

  1. The return path gives loop R=2rℓ,X=2xℓ;do not double an already supplied loop impedance.
  2. Write Iphasor=I(cosφ−j sinφ);the in-phase component of ZloopIis I(Rcosφ+Xsinφ).
  3. Thus approximate ΔV=2Iℓ(rcosφ+xsinφ);leading reactive term reverses and exact work uses phasor magnitudes.

Interpretation and check

For stated r0.007Ω/m,xneglected,ℓ20m,I10A,unity pf:drop2.8V,about1.2174%of230V.These are supplied teaching data,not an ampacity approval.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Single-phase two-wire,one-way ℓ/per-conductor r-x અને lagging I લો.Small-drop approximation છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Return pathથી R=2rℓ/X=2xℓ છે.Already loop dataને ફરી double નકરો.
  2. Iphasor=I(cosφ−j sinφ) લો.ZloopIનો in-phase ભાગ I(Rcosφ+Xsinφ) છે.
  3. તેથી ΔV≈2Iℓ(rcosφ+xsinφ) છે.Leadingમાં reactive sign બદલાય;exactમાં phasor magnitudes લો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Given r0.007Ω/m,xignore,ℓ20m,I10A/unity pfમાં drop2.8V એટલે230Vના લગભગ1.2174% છે.આ teaching data છે,ampacity approval નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A main isolating device disconnects the required live conductors for its rated duty;a distribution board divides incoming power into identified protected outgoing circuits.

Explanation and application

  • MCB/fuse handles specified overload/short-circuit duties;RCCBdetects residual imbalance but does not itself provide overload protection;RCBOcombines both specified functions.
  • Select poles,voltage,current,utilisation duty,busbar/way capacity,enclosure,breaking/withstand ratings and coordination;provide sensible spare ways and labels.
  • Residual sensitivity such as an assumed30mAis not its load-current rating and not a guarantee against every shock.Nand PEgrouping and neutral segregation must follow the approved scheme.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Main isolating device required live conductorsને rated dutyમાં disconnect કરે.DB incoming powerને identified protected outgoing circuitsમાં વહેંચે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • MCB-fuse overcurrent duties કરે.RCCB residual imbalance detect કરે પણ પોતે overload protection નથી.RCBO બંને functions જોડે છે.
  • Poles,V,I,duty,busbar-ways,enclosure,breaking-withstand/coordination લો.Spare ways/labels આપો.
  • Assumed30mA sensitivity load-current rating નથી/દરેક shockની guarantee નથી.N-PE grouping/neutral segregation approved scheme પ્રમાણે રાખો.

body.en:
Definition

A residual-current protective device monitors the algebraic sum of instantaneous currents in the monitored live conductors and initiates disconnection when the specified residual-current/time conditions occur.

Explanation and application

  • Line/neutral conductors of the protected circuit pass through the sensing arrangement;PEdoes not carry normal monitored load return.RCCBstill needs coordinated overcurrent protection.
  • A balanced line-to-neutral shock/fault may not create residual imbalance;RCDdoes not replace insulation,PE/bonding or safe isolation.
  • Residual sensitivity,mains rating,device type,trip behaviour and test method are separate specifications.The test button checks a function,not every installation parameter.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

RCD monitored live conductorsના instantaneous currentsનો algebraic sum monitor કરી specified residual-current/time conditionsમાં disconnection કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Protected line-neutral sensingમાંથી જાય;PE normal return નથી.RCCBને coordinated overcurrent protection જોઈએ.
  • Balanced L-Nshock/faultમાં residual imbalance નબને.RCD insulation,PE/isolationનો substitute નથી.
  • Sensitivity,rated load I,type,trip/test method અલગ specs છે.Test button complete installation check નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Installation verification is documented inspection and testing to determine whether the installed system meets its applicable design/safety requirements before service or during prescribed review.

Explanation and application

  • Start with visual inspection,identification,protective/bonding continuity,polarity checks and insulation tests under approved isolated conditions.Identify all possible sources and prove dead correctly.
  • Insulation testing uses equipment/standard-specific voltage and limits;sensitive electronics/SPDsrequire authorised treatment.Megger output is hazardous;discharge and verify residual voltage afterwards.
  • Earth/loop/RCDfunctional and trip tests that need energisation are for qualified authorised personnel using rated instruments and a risk-controlled procedure;the RCDtest button is not the entire verification.
  • Use actual acceptance criteria,measurement uncertainty and defects;never assign universal5Ωor1MΩpass limits without the applicable system/test basis.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Installed system applicable design-safety requirements સંતોષે છે કે નહીં તે documented inspection/testsથી નક્કી કરવું verification છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Visual,identity,PE-bond continuity,polarity/insulation dead testsથી શરૂ કરો.All sources ઓળખી યોગ્ય dead verification કરો.
  • Insulation testV/limits equipment-standard પ્રમાણે લો.Electronics-SPDનું authorised treatment કરો.Tester hazardous DCઆપે;પછી discharge/residual Vverify કરો.
  • Energised earth-loop-RCD trip tests qualified authorised personnel rated instrumentsથી કરે.RCD test button complete verification નથી.
  • Actual criteria,uncertainty/defects લો.System-test basis વિના universal5Ω/1MΩ pass limit નઆપો.

body.en:
Definition

An electrical test report is a traceable record of installation identity,inspection/test methods,actual results,applicable criteria,defects and authorised verification;it is not merely a signed blank form.

Explanation and application

  • Record owner/site,circuit schedule,supply/earthing system,drawings,ratings,instrument identity/calibration,date,test conditions and responsible authorised person.
  • List each actual continuity,insulation,polarity,earth/loop and RCDresult with units,method and criterion;mark untested items Not tested,not Passed.
  • Record defects,limitations,required rectification,retest and authorisation before service.Do not copy fictional readings,signatures or utility approval.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electrical test report installation identity,methods,actual results,criteria,defects/authorised verificationનો traceable record છે;ફક્ત signed blank form નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Site,circuits,supply-earthing system,drawings,ratings,instrument-calibration,date,conditions/person લખો.
  • Actual continuity,insulation,polarity,earth-loop/RCD results units-method-criterion સાથે લો.Untestedને Not tested લખો,Passed નહીં.
  • Defects,limits,rectification,retest/authorisation લો.Fictional readings,signatures/approval નકરો.

body.en:
Definition

Protective earthing connects specified exposed conductive parts to the protective system so fault protection and touch-voltage control can operate;neutral is an operational conductor with a different role.

Explanation and application

  • Earthing,bonding,automatic disconnection,RCDwhere required and correct insulation work together;one low electrode resistance value alone does not certify the installation.
  • No PEfuses/switches,neutral-as-earth shortcuts,oversized replacement breakers or defeated residual protection.A double-insulated product is treated according to its actual class/design,not indiscriminately drilled for PE.
  • Wet locations,outdoor equipment,children,fire risk and alternative supplies require the applicable additional precautions;students should not perform live domestic work.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Protective earthing specified exposed partsને protective system સાથે જોડે જેથી fault protection/touch control કામ કરે.Neutral અલગ operational conductor છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Earthing,bonding,disconnection,RCD/insulation સાથે કામ કરે.ફક્ત low earth Rથી installation certify નથી થતી.
  • PE fuse-switch,neutral-earth shortcut,oversized breaker/RCD bypass નકરો.Double-insulated productમાં class-design અનુસરો;મનસ્વી PE drill નહીં.
  • Wet-outdoor,children,fire/alternative suppliesમાં additional precautions લો.Student live domestic work નકરે.

body.en:
Definition

Earth-fault loop impedance is the total impedance of the source,line conductor,fault path and protective return circuit carrying earth-fault current;it is not simply the electrode resistance measured by an earth tester.

Explanation and application

  • The return path depends on TN/TT/ITsystem design;identify the earthing arrangement before selecting a disconnection criterion.
  • Continuity,bonding,fault current,device trip characteristics and permitted touch voltage/time act together.
  • Measuring live loop impedance requires qualified authorised testing,not connecting a homemade test load between line and earth.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Earth-fault loop impedance source,line,fault path/protective returnની total impedance છે;તે ફક્ત earth testerનું electrode resistance નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Return path TN-TT-IT system પર આધારિત છે.Criteria પહેલાં earthing arrangement ઓળખો.
  • Continuity,bonding,fault I,trip curve/touch V-time સાથે ધ્યાનમાં લો.
  • Live loop test qualified authorised personnel કરે.Homemade line-earth load નજોડો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative TNloop,nominal U0and required device operating current Iafor the specified clearing time;ignore source-voltage variation only for this simplified relation.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Approximate earth-fault current If=U0/Zsfrom the complete fault-loop voltage equation.
  2. Require If≥Ia;therefore Zs≤U0/Ia.
  3. For supplied U0230Vand Ia160A,Zs,max=1.4375Ω.This is not a universal earth-electrode pass limit.

Interpretation and check

Iaand clearing time must come from the actual approved device/system method;do not apply this TNexample indiscriminately to TT/RCDdesign.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Illustrative TNloopમાં U0/required timeનું Ia લો.આ simplified relationમાં જ voltage variation ignore કરો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Complete loopથી If≈U0/Zs છે.
  2. If≥Ia જોઈએ;તેથી Zs≤U0/Ia છે.
  3. Supplied U0230V/Ia160Aમાં Zs,max=1.4375Ω છે.આ universal earth-electrode limit નથી.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Ia/time actual approved methodથી લો.TNexampleને TT-RCDdesignમાં indiscriminately નલાગુ કરો.

title.en: 2.10 Domestic estimate:transparent material and cost case

આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Assumed material BOQ:180conductor-m₹25/m,60conduit-m₹30/m,12accessory sets₹150,DB₹3000/earthing₹1200 લો.Fixtures-appliances,tax-utility fees excluded છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  2. Assumed labour20%M=₹2460/direct D=₹14760 છે.

body.en:
Definition

Illuminance is incident luminous flux per unit area,measured in lux;it is not electrical power or subjective brightness.

Given and assumptions

Illuminance Emeans luminous flux per unit area in lux.Assume room10m×6m,E300lux,luminaire3000lumens,utilisation factor UF0.6,maintenance factor MF0.8;not a mandated office value.

Step-by-step solution
